description: Client half of XH's Hoist toolkit: React + MobX, element-factory components, HoistModel and HoistService, ag-Grid grids, forms, dashboards, persistence, routing. Pairs with hoist-core.
rules: Render components with element factories (panel({...}), grid({...})) rather than JSX. Pass children via item/items and use the omit prop for conditional rendering.

Every @observable, @observableRef, @bindable, and @bindableRef field needs the accessor keyword, e.g. `@bindable accessor name = ''`. Decorators on getters, methods, and plain fields (@computed, @action, @managed, @lookup) do not.

Wire components to models with creates(ModelClass) when the component owns the model, or uses(ModelClass) when a parent supplies it via props or context. lookupModel and @lookup work only in linked models during or after onLinked.
Mark child HoistBase instances with @managed so they are destroyed with their owner. Subscribe with this.addReaction() and this.addAutorun() from HoistBase, not raw MobX reaction() or autorun().

Opt into managed loading by overriding doLoadAsync(loadSpec) and trigger it with loadAsync() or refreshAsync(); never call doLoadAsync directly. Pass loadSpec through to XH.fetchJson and nested loads.

Reach services and app-wide APIs through the XH singleton (XH.fetchJson, XH.configService, XH.toast, XH.confirm, XH.handleException, XH.myCustomService). App services extend HoistService and are installed with XH.installServicesAsync.
Use Hoist input components (textInput, numberInput, select, checkbox, dateInput, textArea) bound to FormModel fields through formField. Do not use raw HTML inputs.
Grid columns are plain ColumnSpec objects in GridConfig.columns. Prefer numberRenderer and dateRenderer from @xh/hoist/format and the pre-built column specs before writing a custom renderer.
Import from package barrels such as @xh/hoist/core, @xh/hoist/cmp/grid, @xh/hoist/desktop/cmp/panel, @xh/hoist/mobx, and @xh/hoist/format, never from internal file paths or impl folders.
Use null, not undefined, as the no-value sentinel and test with == null. Suffix promise-returning methods with Async.

Wrap async work in the Runner chain: this.runner(ctx).span('loadX').linkTo(taskObserver).track({...}).run(async ctx => ...) or its fetchJson() terminal. Compose masking, tracking, and spans there, not by chaining promise extensions off a bare promise.

When the app's @xh/hoist major differs from the docs, read docs/upgrade-notes/v<major>-upgrade-notes.md and docs/version-compatibility.md; each hoist-react major pairs with specific hoist-core versions.
